messages:
eli: heads up — we started seeing a bunch of new root spans for requests that should be child spans, surfaced in the dashboard an hour ago. noticed spike on /api/generate route :eyes:

tara: hmm, any deploys around that time?

eli: small ingress change 02:10am — added response/request compression middleware (gzip) to the proxy to save bandwidth.

devon: could compression middleware be doing header normalization? I've seen libraries move headers into lowercase and drop some weird ones.

eli: checking logs now. otel export show a lot of child spans with missing parentIDs. also traces show tracestate present upstream but missing in collector events.

raj: can we grep the proxy logs for tracestate/traceparent at ingress vs collector?

eli: ran quick search. upstream request has both traceparent and tracestate. proxy access log shows tracestate present, but downstream request to the sidecar shows only traceparent. tracestate removed.

devon: that points at the compression layer or its header sanitizer. IIRC we added a header whitelist for compressed payloads to prevent CRLF injection.

tara: if tracestate is dropped then samplers downstream can't correlate children with parents — that would make them appear as roots and inflate retention. makes sense.

eli: snippet from proxy config added in last deploy: ```yaml
middleware:
  compress: true
  sanitize_headers:
    allow: [Host, User-Agent, Accept, Content-Type, Authorization, Traceparent]
```

eli: note: Traceparent is included but tracestate is not. oops.

raj: yep that's the bug. whitespace on our allowed header list and we only allowed 'Traceparent'. tracestate omitted.

devon: mitigation: roll back compress middleware or add tracestate to allow list. quick fix = update config and reload proxy.

tara: any risk adding tracestate back? we had it out because of concern for long tracestate values hitting header size limits for compressed requests. but we can evaluate.

eli: immediate plan: 1) add tracestate to allow list and reload 2) run a synthetic trace across /api/generate to verify child spans now link 3) deploy small rollout to prod-1 region

raj: also add quick dashboard alert for sudden increase in orphaned-roots percent and for tracer retention cardinality — we were blind until this spike.

devon: note for postmortem: include why header whitelist existed and constraints around header-length with compression. consider moving to explicit header pass-through rather than whitelist.

eli: making the change now and will paste reload logs.

otel-bot: deploy: config-reload started by eli on proxy-prod-1 at 2004321580

eli: reload done. verified header allow list includes tracestate. performing synthetic trace now. curl from staging: `curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-abcdabcdabcdabcdabcdabcdabcdabcd-0000000000000001-01" -H "tracestate: vendor=xyz" https://proxy-prod-1/api/generate`

eli: collector shows traceparent + tracestate arriving. child spans linked. percentage of orphaned-roots dropped from 12.4% -> 0.8% in last 5m.

tara: great. can we get a short rollback/mitigation note in the deploy PR? also we should add a lint to catch header whitelist omissions.

devon: I'll open a tiny RFC: "header sanitizer semantics for compression middleware". propose: always forward traceparent/tracestate and enforce max header size rather than blanket drop.

raj: and add a telemetry test to e2e: generate trace with tracestate length ~3KB and ensure proxy preserves it (or returns 431 if too large).

eli: logging follow-up: added debug line in proxy to trace header transformations for next 48h.

tara: thanks team. filing incident note and tagging oncall.

otel-bot: incident: telemetry-orphans-200432 — severity: sev3 — assignees: eng-platform

eli: filing postmortem draft now, will attach config snippets and timeframe.

devon: small action items: (1) add tracestate to default allowed headers in middleware repo (2) add e2e + size limit test (3) update runbooks to mention compression sanitizer caveat

raj: closing loop: is there any persistent retention/cost impact we need to bill to infra budget? we had extra retention events for ~45 minutes.

tara: finance/infra impact appears small but include numbers in postmortem. ok to close once PR merges and e2e green. :thumbsup:
